title: 第6章 一阶基因锁的恐怖威能！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

罗兰双目茫然，一种强悍恐怖的力量不断在体内浮现！

他的肌肉在膨胀、体质在飙升、神经网络运转更加顺畅、感知更加敏锐！

而与此同时，一股股深藏在基因深处的战斗本能，此刻宛如火山爆发一般，不断在罗兰心中喷涌而出！

在这种战斗本能的影响下，罗兰下意识地运转基本呼吸法。

他微微呼吸，体内的肌肉、骨骼、内脏乃至血液流动，此刻骤然发生了微妙变化！

原本彼此自顾自的各个血肉组织，如今和谐无比，宛如整体！

而原本难以入门的基本呼吸法，此刻竟然像是反掌观纹一样容易，不到一瞬间就被罗兰成功练成！

入门后的基本呼吸法，让罗兰能调动自己更多的肌肉力量！

此刻，罗兰双目茫然，没有转身回头，便已经察觉到了身后悄然来临的危机！

没有犹豫，更不需要思考，罗兰刀没有出鞘，而是直接转身用刀鞘狠狠拍向朝他扑来的丧尸猫！

在开启一阶基因锁的状态下，他的各大属性，已经有了爆炸式的增长！

此刻，罗兰的属性变成了力量14、体质14、敏捷13、感知14！

而这种平衡的属性，比起丧尸猫更加强悍！

虽然他的敏捷还差了丧尸猫一点，但是这一点的差距并不大！

敏捷属性，虽然和速度有关联，但是对速度的影响并不巨大！

此刻，已经转身的罗兰，能清楚看到跳到半空，朝他扑来丧尸猫的移动轨迹！

时间的流逝仿佛慢了下来，在罗兰眼中，丧尸猫和他拍出的刀鞘正在逐步接近......

在缓慢的视角里，罗兰看到，丧尸猫身体微弓，四肢轻微舒展，似乎想要强行在空中改变姿势。

但是罗兰此刻的敏捷属性，并不比丧尸猫弱多少！

甚至，他的力量属性，还要超过丧尸猫！

而且，在10级战斗本能的加持下，罗兰的出手时机把握得非常完美，无论是出招的角度亦或者是对后续丧尸猫行动的预判，都没有任何瑕疵！

刀鞘狠狠拍在了丧尸猫身上！

顿时，丧尸猫宛如皮球一样被狠狠打飞了出去，直接撞碎了窗户玻璃，落到了外面。

而就在这时，罗兰双耳微动，已经听到徐海

“还剩下58秒！”

如果这时有别人在场，就能发现罗兰双目茫然，眼神空洞，仿佛在发呆一样。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Roland's eyes were blank, and a powerful and terrifying force kept emerging in his body!

His muscles are expanding, his physique is soaring, his neural network is operating more smoothly, and his perception is sharper!

At the same time, the fighting instincts hidden deep in the genes were constantly erupting in Roland's heart like a volcano erupting!

Under the influence of this fighting instinct, Roland subconsciously operated the basic breathing method.

He breathed slightly, and the muscles, bones, internal organs and even blood flow in his body suddenly underwent subtle changes at this moment!

The various flesh and blood tissues that were originally independent of each other are now in perfect harmony, like a whole!

The basic breathing method that was originally difficult to learn was now as easy as looking at the lines with the palm of your hand, and Roland successfully practiced it in less than an instant!

The basic breathing method after getting started allows Roland to mobilize more muscle strength!

At this moment, Roland's eyes were blank. Without turning around, he had already noticed the crisis coming quietly behind him!

Without hesitation, let alone thinking, Roland's knife did not take out its sheath. Instead, he turned around and slapped the zombie cat that rushed toward him with the scabbard!

With the first-level gene lock activated, his major attributes have increased explosively!

At this moment, Roland's attributes became Strength 14, Constitution 14, Agility 13, and Perception 14!

And this kind of balanced attribute is more powerful than zombie cats!

Although his agility is still a little behind the zombie cat, the difference is not big!

Although the agility attribute is related to speed, it does not have a huge impact on speed!

At this moment, Roland, who had turned around, could clearly see the trajectory of the zombie cat that jumped into the air and rushed towards him!

The passage of time seemed to slow down. In Roland's eyes, the zombie cat and the scabbard he photographed were gradually approaching...

From the slow perspective, Roland saw that the zombie cat's body was slightly arched and its limbs were slightly stretched, as if it wanted to forcefully change its posture in the air.

But Roland's agility attribute at this moment is not much weaker than that of a zombie cat!

In fact, his strength attribute is even greater than that of a zombie cat!

Moreover, with the blessing of level 10 combat instinct, Roland's timing of attack was perfect. There were no flaws in either the angle of the attack or the prediction of the subsequent zombie cat's actions!

The scabbard slapped the zombie cat hard!

Suddenly, the zombie cat was hit hard like a ball, smashed the window glass, and fell outside.

At this moment, Roland's ears moved slightly and he heard Xu Hai's

"58 seconds left!"

If there were others present at this time, they would have noticed that Roland's eyes were blank and empty, as if he was in a daze.
